# Parity checklist (generated by `cargo xtask parity`)

Target: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM (feature names only; clean-room).

**Feature areas:** 29 / 35 covered.

| Area | Feature | Status | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduling | Forward/backward pass, FS/SS/FF/SF, leads/lags | ✅ | `prswt-cpm passes.rs` |

| Scheduling | Constraints: SNET/SNLT/FNET/FNLT/On/Mandatory/ALAP | ✅ | `passes.rs` |
| Scheduling | Must finish by, negative float | ✅ | `late_end` |
| Scheduling | Retained logic / progress override | ✅ | `ProgressMode` |
| Scheduling | Total float start/finish/smallest, free float | ✅ | `floats()` |
| Scheduling | Critical: TF threshold / longest path | ✅ | `analysis.rs` |
| Scheduling | Multiple float paths | ✅ | `float_paths` |
| Scheduling | Activity types: task, resource-dependent, LOE, milestones, WBS summary | ✅ | `ActivityKind` |
| Scheduling | Out-of-sequence progress detection report | ⬜ | `gaps.md` |
| Scheduling | Expected finish dates / suspend-resume | ⬜ | `gaps.md` |

| Calendars | Shifts crossing midnight | ✅ | `interval merge` |

| WBS/OBS | OBS / responsible manager security | ⬜ | `gaps.md` |

| Resources | Resource curves | ✅ | `SpreadCurve` |
| Resources | Usage profiles, overallocation | ✅ | `histogram` |
| Resources | Resource leveling (priority, preserve float) | ✅ | `level.rs` |
| Resources | Roles and role-based assignment | ⬜ | `gaps.md` |
| Costs | Expenses, cost accounts, WBS budgets | ✅ | `cost_rollup` |
| EVM | Baselines, PV/EV/AC, CPI/SPI, EAC/ETC/VAC/TCPI | ✅ | `prswt-evm` |
| EVM | Earned schedule SPI(t) | ✅ | `evaluate` |
| EVM | Multiple baselines compare in Gantt | ⬜ | `gaps.md` |
| Analysis | Schedule check (DCMA 14) | ✅ | `dcma.rs` |
| Risk | Risk register with pre/post mitigation | ✅ | `Risk` |

| UI | Network (PERT) diagram | ⬜ | `gaps.md` |
